title.narrative: Strengthening regional links and transition sharing in the wider Black Sea Region

description.narrative: The specific objective this grant is to strengthen intra-regional sharing of transition experience and practice. As result: At least 50 regional projects for CSOs from EaP and the wider Black Sea region (at least three) will have been implemented; regional links and networks of CSOs will have been strengthened. A transition sharing channel will have been set up to allow CSOs in new EU Member States and CSOs in the EaP and beyond to share experiences and transfer knowledge
